definitions: Unable to leave one's home or a place, often due to restrictions, illness, or bad weather.
Unable to be removed or extinguished, referring to a stain or a fire.
Unable to be in a romantic relationship with someone.
examples: I can't go out tonight because I'm sick.
The red wine stain just can't go out of this carpet.
They can't go out anymore; their parents forbid it.
pastTenses: couldn't go out, couldn't go out
